dict.string: This is just a sample. Do NOT try loading it.
Ensure you understand EVERY field before booting.
In most cases recommended to use Sample.plist
Use SampleCustom.plist only for special cases.
Replace one byte sequence with another
M8: XS3 to _S3 (firmware hides S3 behind Modern Standby)
M8: SS3 Zero to One (allow _PRW wake from S3)
M8: PCIe ECAM 0xE0000000 (fw SetVariable may use PCI config)
Haswell: SB_RCBA is a 0x4 page memory region, containing SPI_BASE at 0x3800 (SPI_BASE_ADDRESS)
Generic: PCI root is a 0x1000 page memory region used by some types of firmware
AMD FCH AcpiMmio 0xFED80000 (fw SetVariable/SMI) - keep runtime mapped
AMD host: AppleIntelMCEReporter NULL-derefs (page fault) on non-Intel hardware (ineffective: kext lives in System KC, OC cannot exclude it; use AppleMCEReporterDisabler.kext)

Send early prints to serial port
Enable early serial output on RELEASE kernel
